notes: Every Delica 11/0 code in Miyuki’s directory, 76 of them discontinued. The color is the plain sRGB mean of Miyuki’s official 400×400 product photo of each code; the photos themselves are not redistributed. Compared with two independent datasets (DianeGagne/beads-website, rowguide) the color family agrees on every code and the shade differs by 6–12 ΔE00 (median): right bead, approximate shade. Metallic, galvanized, AB and silver-lined beads cannot be one flat color. Miyuki publishes no color names; names are built from Miyuki’s own terms. `glass` is the glass type.
